news.summary: Jim Lebenthal sees a dip and keeps buying, betting on a handful of businesses firing at once. The filings back much of his case, but one number in Alphabet's latest quarter could decide whether his optimism holds.

news.summary: Alphabet owns a piece of Anthropic and also gets paid to supply its computing power, which is a nice way to be on both sides of the AI boom.

news.summary: David Tepper sold off three AI winners that were still growing fast and bought two others instead. One of them pays its own way, while the other leans heavily on borrowed money and customer prepayments.
news.title: Tepper Trims Alphabet by ~46% and Dumps Broadcom & AMD While Backing Micron and Oracle
news.title_zh: Tepper 削減 Alphabet 持股約 ~46% 並拋售 Broadcom 與 AMD，同時看好 Micron 和 Oracle
news.summary_zh: David Tepper 拋售了三檔仍在快速成長的 AI 獲利股，並改為買入另外兩檔。其中一檔能自我造血，而另一檔則高度依賴借款和客戶預付款。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom fell 15% in the past week and hit a 52-week low, mostly after analyst Ming-Chi Kuo said Alphabet’s Google cut 2027 shipments of one Broadcom-designed TPU line by about 20%. Marvell fell too, and Anthropic’s slide below its IPO price added to the selling.
news.title: Broadcom Sinks 15% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Google Reportedly Cuts TPU Orders. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Broadcom 過去一週下跌 15%，觸及 52 週低點，主要是因分析師郭明錤表示 Alphabet 旗下 Google 削減了 2027 出貨量，約減少 20%。Marvell 也下跌，Anthropic 跌破 IPO 價格加劇了拋售。

news.summary: A large equity stake and nearly guaranteed cloud sales make Anthropic's future success a boon for Alphabet.
news.title: 2 Ways Anthropic's IPO Pays Off for Alphabet Investors
news.title_zh: 2 種 Anthropic IPO 為 Alphabet 投資人帶來回報的方式
news.summary_zh: 龐大的股權持有和幾乎確定的雲端銷售，使 Anthropic 未來的成功成為 Alphabet 的利多。

news.summary: Analyst rates Broadcom a Buy: shares price in roughly two-thirds of its $230B FY28 AI outlook, while Anthropic's 5 GW could absorb secured capacity.
news.title: Broadcom: The Google Scare Is Overdone
news.title_zh: Broadcom：Google 恐慌被過度解讀
news.summary_zh: 分析師評級 Broadcom 為買入：股價已反映其 $230B FY28 AI 展望的約三分之二，而 Anthropic 的 5 GW 可吸收已鎖定產能。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic fell below its $83 IPO price on Tuesday, its fourth day of trading. Bill Gurley says few of the IPO’s buyers planned to hold the stock.
news.title: Bill Gurley: Investors Weren’t “Scrambling to Actually Own Anthropic.” That’s a Problem for Amazon and Alphabet
news.title_zh: Bill Gurley：投資者並非「爭相實際持有 Anthropic」。這對 Amazon 和 Alphabet 是個問題
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Anthropic 週二跌破其 $83 IPO 價格，為上市第四個交易日。Bill Gurley 表示，IPO 買家中鮮少人計劃長期持有該股票。

news.summary: It's never cost more to insure Alphabet's debt.
news.title: Why Alphabet Stock Is Down Today
news.title_zh: 為何 Alphabet 股價今日下跌
news.summary_zh: 為 Alphabet 債務投保的成本從未如此之高。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) isn’t “serving open source models” after CNBC reported that its Cursor unit is considering phasing out Chinese-developed models. The Trump administration is reportedly weighing a rule requiring companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI models such as Alibaba’s (BABA:NYSE) Qwen, and Cursor’s Composer 2 was built on a version of Moonshot AI’s Kimi.
news.title: Musk Says SpaceX’s Cursor Isn’t “Serving Open Source Models” as Trump Weighs Outing Chinese AI Users
news.title_zh: Musk 稱 SpaceX 的 Cursor 並非「提供開源模型」，而 Trump 考慮揭露中國 AI 用戶
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Elon Musk 表示 SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) 並非「提供開源模型」，此前 CNBC 報導其 Cursor 單位正考慮逐步淘汰中國開發的模型。據報導，Trump 行政部門正權衡一項規定，要求公司揭露其使用中國 AI 模型的情況，例如 Alibaba (BABA:NYSE) 的 Qwen，而 Cursor 的 Composer 2 是基於 Moonshot AI 的 Kimi 版本構建的。

news.title: Keel Point LLC Sells 518,846 Shares of Netflix, Inc. $NFLX
news.summary: Keel Point LLC cut its position in shares of Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX - Free Report) by 80.7% during the third quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 124,429 shares of the Internet television network's stock after selling 518,846 shares
news.title_zh: Keel Point LLC 出售 Netflix, Inc. 518,846 股股票 $NFLX
news.summary_zh: 根據向 SEC 提交的最新 Form 13F 申報，Keel Point LLC 在第三季度將其持有的 Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX - Free Report) 股份減少了 80.7%。該機構投資者在出售 518,846 股後，持有該網路電視網路股票 124,429 股。

news.summary: The streaming giant's stock looks cheap to me around $60. Three numbers might change my mind.
news.title: Here's What Would Prove Me Wrong About Netflix Stock
news.title_zh: 這裡有什麼會證明我對 Netflix 股票的看法是錯的
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭的股票在我看來在 $60 左右很便宜。三個數字可能會改變我的想法。

news.summary: Netflix just landed Disney's library, record margins, and a forward P/E of 15, yet the stock keeps sliding toward its 52-week low. One overlooked detail in the deal may explain why Wall Street's bulls and bears are both right.
news.title: Netflix Stock Is Down 36% in 2026. Can Its Disney Partnership Make It a Buy Again?
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價在 2026 下跌 36%。其與 Disney 的合作能否使其再度成為買進對象？

news.title: Netflix Buys Seinfeld Studio Lot After Goldman Forecloses
news.summary: Bloomberg's John Gittelsohn joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Netflix announced it’s buying Radford Studio Center, the historic Los Angeles lot where Seinfeld was filmed, for $380 million after Goldman Sachs Group took control of the property. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Netflix 在 Goldman 沒收後購入《宋飛正傳》攝影棚廠區
news.summary_zh: 彭博社的 John Gittelsohn 與 Scarlet Fu 共同主持「彭博交易」。Netflix 宣佈以 $380 million 購入 Radford Studio Center，這座位於洛杉磯的歷史廠區是《宋飛正傳》的拍攝地，此前 Goldman Sachs Group 已接管該物業。（來源：彭博社）

news.title: Netflix to Buy Radford Studio Center for $380 Million
news.summary: Bloomberg's John Gittelsohn discusses Netflix’s purchase of the historic Radford Studio Center in Los Angeles. The $380 million price is about 80% below the $1.85 billion Hackman Capital Partners paid for the property in 2021. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Netflix 將以 $380 Million 收購 Radford Studio Center
news.summary_zh: 彭博社的 John Gittelsohn 討論 Netflix 收購洛杉磯歷史悠久的 Radford Studio Center。此次 $380 million 價格比 Hackman Capital Partners 於 2021 以 $1.85 billion 購入該物業的價格低約 80%。(來源：彭博社)

news.summary: Netflix's profits are surging while its shares keep sliding, leaving the stock far below its April peak. Two 2027 catalysts could flip that script, but a few stubborn hurdles might get in the way.
news.title: Netflix Has 2 Growth Engines That Could Drive Its Stock Higher in 2027
news.title_zh: Netflix 擁有 2 個成長引擎，可能在 2027 推高其股價

news.summary: While Netflix did not disclose the deal value, according to a report from Los Angeles Times, the purchase was completed at a value of $380 million.
news.title: NFLX Stock Edges Lower Overnight: Streaming Giant Buys Historic ‘Seinfeld’ Studio Lot In Reported $380M Deal
news.title_zh: NFLX 股價盤後微跌：串流巨頭購入歷史性《宋飛正傳》攝影棚場地，據報交易金額 $380M
news.summary_zh: 雖然 Netflix 未披露交易價值，但據《洛杉磯時報》報導，購買完成價值為 $380 million。

news.summary: Netflix stock is down 56% from its summer 2025 peak. Here's what the sell-off may be missing about the thriving business.
news.title: Netflix Stock Is Down 37% in 2026, But the Business Is Still Growing. Here's Why I'd Buy It Before the End of November.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價下跌 37% 於 2026，但業務仍在增長。這是為什麼我會在十一月底前買入的原因。
news.summary_zh: Netflix 股價較夏季 2025 高點下跌 56%。這裡說明拋售潮可能忽略了這項蓬勃業務的哪些面向。

news.summary: Trading 57% off its all-time record, the streaming stock has been crushed.
news.title: Is Netflix a Buy for $1,000?
news.title_zh: Netflix 是否適合在 $1,000 買入？
news.summary_zh: 距離歷史最高紀錄 57%，這檔串流股票已遭重挫。

news.summary: Can Netflix get out of its current doldrums?
news.title: The Last Time Netflix Was This Cheap, the Stock Jumped 600%. Is It a Buy Now?
news.title_zh: 上一次 Netflix 這麼便宜時，股價飆升了 600%。現在值得買進嗎？
news.summary_zh: Netflix 能否擺脫目前的低迷？

news.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
news.summary: Netflix (NFLX) keeps more of each sales dollar than almost every company in its peer group. Yet its stock is one of the cheapest in that group. Among five companies, Netflix ranks second on operating margin. It has the fourth-highest price to earnings ratio, which makes it the second cheapest. So is Netflix stock worth more than its competitors.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股票是否比其競爭對手更有價值？
news.summary_zh: Netflix (NFLX) 保留的每一美元銷售額比同業幾乎所有公司都多。然而其股票在該群組中卻是最便宜的之一。在五家公司中，Netflix 的營業利潤率排名第二。其市盈率排名第四高，使其成為第二便宜。那麼 Netflix 股票是否比競爭對手更有價值。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix fired its chief content officer and about 1,000 employees in October as its growth slows. YouTube took 15.
news.title: Netflix Cuts About 1,000 Jobs and Its Content Chief. YouTube Already Has Twice Its TV Share
news.title_zh: Netflix 裁減約 1,000 個職位及其內容長。YouTube 已擁有其兩倍電視份額
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Netflix 在十月解僱其首席內容官及約 1,000 名員工，因其增長放緩。YouTube 佔據了 15。

news.summary: Three Treasury warnings in ten days, and the Fed still hasn't blinked. While stocks swing wildly, long bonds barely budge, and that gap reveals what investors truly expect before the December 9 decision.
news.title: Bessent Warns the Fed Could Be Making a “Policy Mistake” if It Over-Tightens
news.title_zh: Bessent 警告若過度緊縮，聯準會可能正在犯下「政策錯誤」
news.summary_zh: 十天內三次財政部警告，聯準會仍未眨眼。股票劇烈波動，長債幾乎不動，這個缺口揭示了投資者在 December 9 決定前的真實預期。

news.summary: Williams gave a calm speech, then said something sharper to reporters. One condition could push the Fed toward another hike right after December, and it decides which Treasury ETFs bruise and which ones recover.
news.title: The New York Fed’s John Williams Won’t Rule Out Back-to-Back Rate Hikes
news.title_zh: 紐約聯準會 John Williams 不排除連續加息
news.summary_zh: 威廉姆斯發表平穩講話，隨後對記者發表更尖銳言論。一項條件可能推動聯準會在十二月後再度加息，這將決定哪些美國公債 ETF 受創、哪些得以復甦。

news.summary: S&P 500 and Dow officially in correction territory. Nasdaq wipes out entire year of gains.
news.title: Market Selloff Deepens As Investors Seek Shelter
news.title_zh: 市場拋售加劇，投資者尋求避風港
news.summary_zh: 標普 500 和道瓊正式進入修正區間。那斯達克抹平全年漲幅。

news.summary: When even a policymaker known for patience starts sounding alarmed, bond buyers lose a key ally. Goolsbee's warning raises a harder question for anyone holding long Treasuries: what happens if the Fed's last dove stops defending them?
news.title: The Fed’s Biggest Dove Sees No Clear Path Back to 2% Inflation
news.title_zh: 聯準會最大鴿派人物看不出回歸 2% 通膨的明確路徑
news.summary_zh: 當連以耐心著稱的決策者開始發出警訊時，債券買家就失去了一位關鍵盟友。古爾斯比的警告對持有長期公債的任何人提出了更棘手的問題：如果聯準會最後一位鴿派人物停止為它們護航，會發生什麼？

news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.
news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.title_zh: 在 3 風險層級的每月檢視：VTEB、TLT 與 EMB 排名
news.summary_zh: 退休族的每月債券基金檢視可能看似穩定，但背後的股價卻悄悄崩塌。根據兩種風險對三檔熱門配息基金排名，產生兩份方向相反的名單，且有一檔基金從安全變得驚悚。

news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%

news.title: Rwanda Wins F1 Hosting Rights in Bet on Tourism
news.summary: Rwanda has been chosen to host Formula 1’s return to Africa, beating competition from South Africa and Morocco. With the first Grand Prix planned for the early 2030s, the country is betting on a new circuit, airport and hotels to drive tourism, create jobs and boost its economy. But can the benefits justify the cost? On Bloomberg’s Next Africa, Jennifer Zabasajja speaks to Rwanda’s Sports Minister Nelly Mukazayire about funding, jobs and the country’s sporting ambitions. Sports economist Victor Matheson examines the potential returns and how much revenue could stay in Rwanda, while FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem discusses the winning bid, affordability and the possibility of more African races. Bloomberg’s Loni Prinsloo looks at the reaction across the continent, South Africa’s disappointment and the infrastructure challenges ahead. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 盧旺達贏得 F1 主辦權，押注旅遊業
news.summary_zh: 盧旺達獲選主辦 Formula 1 重返非洲，擊敗南非和摩洛哥的競爭。首場大獎賽規劃在 2030 年代初期舉行，該國押注新賽道、機場和飯店帶動觀光、創造就業並提振經濟。但效益能否證明成本合理？在彭博《Next Africa》節目中，Jennifer Zabasajja 訪問盧旺達體育部長 Nelly Mukazayire，談論資金、就業與國家體育雄心。體育經濟學家 Victor Matheson 分析潛在回報及有多少收入可留在盧旺達，國際汽聯主席 Mohammed Ben Sulayem 則討論中標案、負擔能力及更多非洲分站賽的可能性。彭博的 Loni Prinsloo 則關注全非洲的反應、南非的失望及未來的基礎建設挑戰。(來源：彭博)

But can the benefits justify the cost? On Bloomberg’s Next Africa, Jennifer Zabasajja speaks to Rwanda’s Sports Minister Nelly Mukazayire about funding, jobs and the country’s sporting ambitions. Sports economist Victor Matheson examines the potential returns and how much revenue could stay in Rwanda, while FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem discusses the winning bid, affordability and the possibility of more African races. Bloomberg’s Loni Prinsloo looks at the reaction across the continent, South Africa’s disappointment and the infrastructure challenges ahead. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.summary: Key TakeawaysFortune reported that Amazon and Meta are in talks to let Meta’s Muse agent shop on Amazon, two months after Amazon blocked it. Walmart already lets Muse shop its Black Friday deals, and Shopify signed on as a Muse partner early, so Amazon is the big holdout.
news.title: Amazon Blocked Meta’s Muse Two Months Ago. Now It’s in Talks to Let It Shop, and Walmart Already Did
news.title_zh: 亞馬遜兩個月前封鎖 Meta 的 Muse。現在正在洽談讓其購物，沃爾瑪已經允許了
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要《財富》報導，亞馬遜和 Meta 正在洽談讓 Meta 的 Muse 代理在亞馬遜上購物，這距離亞馬遜封鎖它已過去兩個月。沃爾瑪已經讓 Muse 購物其黑色星期五優惠，Shopify 早早簽約成為 Muse 合作夥伴，因此亞馬遜是最大的拒絕者。

news.summary: A deal would bring Muse back into Amazon's store. But Muse's shopping fees are still just a plan.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan’s credit default swap data puts Meta and Broadcom in a “stretched” tier at about 160 basis points, about twice the 80 basis points for Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon. Meta has no cloud business, so its ads have to pay for its AI build-out, and borrowing covers the gap.
news.title: Meta’s Credit Swaps Cost About Twice Microsoft’s and Alphabet’s, per JPMorgan Data. That’s a Problem for Its Capex
news.title_zh: 根據摩根大通數據，Meta 的信用掉期成本約為微軟和 Alphabet 的兩倍。這對其資本支出是個問題
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要摩根大通的信用違約掉期數據將 Meta 和博通置於約 160 basis points 的「緊繃」層級，約為微軟、Alphabet 和亞馬遜的 80 basis points 的兩倍。Meta 沒有雲端業務，因此其廣告必須為其 AI 建設付費，而借貸則彌補了缺口。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30, 65 bought Meta and 34 sold, while 178 held it at the quarter’s end.
news.title: George Soros and 64 Other Big Funds Bought Meta Last Quarter. David Tepper and 33 Others Sold. Who’s Right?
news.title_zh: George Soros 和 64 家其他大型基金上季買入 Meta。David Tepper 和 33 家其他基金賣出。誰是對的？

news.title_zh: Meta Platforms 剛與 Walmart 合作。投資人應關注的原因
news.summary_zh: Meta 成功將 Walmart 納為購物合作夥伴，可能預示這家科技龍頭的 AI 支出最終能獲得回報。

news.summary: Banks are preparing a multibillion-dollar loan for CoreWeave at a rate far below what its own bondholders demand. The gap reveals who is really on the hook, and why shareholders may be last in line.
news.title: CoreWeave Can Now Borrow at 7% With Meta’s Name on the Loan
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 現在可在 Meta 為貸款背書下以 7% 借款
news.summary_zh: 銀行正為 CoreWeave 準備數十億美元貸款，利率遠低於其自身債券持有人要求的水準。這一差距揭示了誰真正承擔風險，以及為何股東可能排在最後。

news.title: Anthropic Broke Its $83 IPO Price. What Did Facebook Do Next?
news.summary: Anthropic (ANT) closed at $82.79 on Wednesday, Nov 25. That is 0.3% below its $83 IPO price. It is also 14.8% below its $97.17 first close, only five trading days in. So what happened to other big listings that broke this fast.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 打破其 $83 IPO 價格。Facebook 接下來做了什麼？
news.summary_zh: Anthropic (ANT) 於週三收於 $82.79，Nov 25。這比其 $83 IPO 價格低 0.3%。也比其 $97.17 首日收盤價低 14.8%，僅五個交易日。那麼其他打破這一速度的大型上市案發生了什麼。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMeta was behind 51% of the AI agents placing orders over the past week, ahead of SpaceX’s Grok at 24%, and Muse can now shop Walmart’s Black Friday deals. A senior Meta executive says Muse raises conversions on the ads Meta already sells, so ads inside the agent can wait.
news.title: Meta Says Muse “Raises Conversions for Advertisers.” It Already Places 51% of AI Agent Orders
news.title_zh: Meta 稱 Muse「提升廣告商轉換率」。其已佔據 51% 的 AI 代理訂單
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Meta 在過去一週佔據 51% 的 AI 代理下單量，領先 SpaceX 的 Grok 之 24%，且 Muse 現可購買 Walmart 的黑色星期五優惠。Meta 高階主管表示 Muse 提升 Meta 現有廣告的轉換率，因此代理內的廣告可以等待。

news.title_zh: 為何美光科技股價今日飆升？
news.summary_zh: 美光科技（NASDAQ:MU）股價飆升 6。0% 在週五盤前交易中，隨著對人工智慧與半導體股票的買盤興趣重燃，支撐了經過數週大幅下跌後的反彈。

news.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor offers a compelling way to capitalize on the artificial intelligence (AI) chip revolution without having to pick a winner among competing chip designers.
news.title: Not Nvidia. Not Micron. If I Could Buy and Hold Only 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Semiconductor Stock Through 2030, This Would Be It.
news.title_zh: 不是輝達。不是美光。若我只能買入並持有 1 檔人工智慧（AI）半導體股票至 2030，那將是它。
news.summary_zh: 台積電提供一種極具吸引力的方式，可在無須在競爭晶片設計商中挑選贏家的情況下，獲利於人工智慧（AI）晶片革命。

news.summary: SK hynix is racing toward 100-layer 3D DRAM while both stocks trade at the same bargain multiple. Income, growth, and risk each pull in a different direction, and one overlooked weakness could decide who survives the next downturn.
news.title: SK Hynix Just Revealed the Next Generation of DRAM. Can It Beat Micron in the Next Memory Supercycle?
news.title_zh: SK Hynix 剛發布新一代 DRAM。能否在下一輪記憶體超級週期中擊敗 Micron？
news.summary_zh: SK hynix 正全力衝刺 100 層 3D DRAM，而兩檔股票目前交易於相同的低估值倍數。獲利、成長與風險各自拉扯不同方向，一個被忽視的弱點可能決定誰能在下一次下行週期中倖存。

news.summary: Micron just posted the most profitable year in its history, yet the stock has shed a third of its value in a month. Memory's long record of boom and bust may explain why investors refuse to pay up.
news.title: Jim Cramer Says Micron Stock Is “Comically Cheap” at About 3 Times Earnings
news.title_zh: Jim Cramer 說 Micron 股票在約 3 Times 盈利下「便宜得可笑」
news.summary_zh: Micron 剛公布史上最獲利的一年，股價卻在一個月內蒸發三分之一。記憶體產業長期的榮枯週期或許能解釋為何投資人拒絕買單。

news.summary: A big memory buyer and a bearish bank are now at least a year apart on when the shortage ends.
news.title: Is Micron Stock a Buy After HPE Said Memory Will Stay Scarce Into 2028?
news.title_zh: HPE 表示記憶體短缺將持續至 2028，Micron 股票現在值得買進嗎？
news.summary_zh: 一大記憶體買家與一家看空銀行，對短缺何時結束的看法目前至少相差一年。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysUBS cut its Micron price target to $1,100 from $1,625 on Nov. 25 but kept its Buy rating, with the stock down 50% from its June record close.
news.title: Micron Can’t Stop Sliding. UBS Cut Its Target, but Still Sees 83% Upside
news.title_zh: Micron 無法止跌。UBS 下調目標價，但仍看好 83% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要UBS 將 Micron 目標價從 $1,625 下調至 $1,100，於 Nov. 25 維持買入評級，股價較六月歷史收盤高點下跌 50%。

news.summary: David Tepper sold off three AI winners that were still growing fast and bought two others instead. One of them pays its own way, while the other leans heavily on borrowed money and customer prepayments.
news.title: Tepper Trims Alphabet by ~46% and Dumps Broadcom & AMD While Backing Micron and Oracle
news.title_zh: Tepper 削減 Alphabet 持股約 ~46% 並拋售 Broadcom 與 AMD，同時看好 Micron 和 Oracle
news.summary_zh: David Tepper 拋售了三檔仍在快速成長的 AI 獲利股，並改為買入另外兩檔。其中一檔能自我造血，而另一檔則高度依賴借款和客戶預付款。

news.title: Micron Stock Has Lost Half Its Value Since June
news.summary: Micron Technology stock closed at $601.25 on Wednesday, Nov 25. It fell 4.5% that day. The stock now sits 50.5% below its record close of $1,213.56 on June 25. A reader of our piece on Micron at under ten times earnings asked for more. Since that request on Nov 19, the stock has dropped another 12.9.
news.title_zh: Micron 股價自六月以來腰斬
news.summary_zh: Micron Technology 股價於週三收於 $601.25，Nov 25。當日下跌 4.5%。股價目前較 June 25 歷史收盤高點 $1,213.56 低 50.5%。我們關於 Micron 低於十倍本益比的文章有讀者詢問更多細節。自該請求於 Nov 19 以來，股價又再下跌 12.9。

news.title: Micron's Margins Peaked Before. How Far Did MU Fall?
news.summary: Micron Technology kept 86.8% of its sales as gross profit in the three months to Sep 3, 2026. That share is called gross margin. It is what Micron keeps from its sales after paying to make its chips. It is the highest of the 115 quarters in our data, back to February 1998.
news.title_zh: Micron 利潤率曾見頂。MU 跌多深？
news.summary_zh: Micron Technology 在截至 Sep 3, 2026 的三個月內，將 86.8% 的營收保留為毛利。這個比例稱為毛利率。這是我們數據中 115 季以來最高的，回溯至 February 1998。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix fell 9% in a week to a new 52-week low as AI chip stocks whipsawed around Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia’s CEO. The deeper worry is a memory downturn in 2028: Goldman Sachs cut its target on lower 2028 prices, and Micron and Sandisk fell even harder.
news.title: SK hynix Just Hit a New 52-Week Low After Sinking 9% in a Week. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.title_zh: SK海力士剛觸及新 52 週低點，單週下跌 9%。賣壓是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SK海力士單週下跌 9%，觸及新 52 週低點，AI晶片股在輝達CEO黃仁勳回歸的消息下劇烈震盪。更深層的擔憂是 2028 的記憶體下行週期：高盛因較低的 2028 價格下調目標價，美光和Sandisk跌幅更大。

news.summary: Nvidia and Kioxia tested 144 flash drives in one AI rack. Kioxia estimates the setup could support a database of up to 2 trillion vectors.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix fell 5% today as Asian chip stocks gave back most of their rally on Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. TrendForce lowered its 2027 memory forecasts after Chinese cloud providers cut orders.

news.summary: SK hynix posted record revenue and profit, yet its shares keep sinking while the AI trade unravels. Two analysts still see a path to $400, but a hidden flaw in the quarter and a brutal cycle could derail it.

news.title_zh: SK 海力士在 30 天內下跌 20%：兩位華爾街專家同意 260% 漲幅將至
news.summary_zh: SK 海力士公布創紀錄營收和利潤，但股價持續下跌，AI 交易解體。兩位分析師仍看好通往 $400 的路徑，但本季隱藏缺陷和殘酷週期可能使其脫軌。

news.summary: The bull case for Micron and SK hynix: buybacks support AI hardware, with KRW20tn left at SK hynix; weaker 2027 AI capex could prolong pain.

news.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs says conventional DRAM prices would have to fall more than 32% to 54% below its base case over two years before memory buyers have a real reason to default on long-term supply agreements. That protects the contracts behind Micron Technology’s (MU:NASDAQ) and SK hynix’s (SKHY:NASDAQ) record earnings, while buyers such as HP (HPQ:NYSE) keep paying more for memory.
news.title: Memory Buyers Lack a “Meaningful Economic Incentive to Default” on Supply Deals, Says Goldman. Good News for Micron
news.title_zh: 高盛稱記憶體買方缺乏「有意義的經濟誘因違約」供貨協議。對美光是好消息
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要高盛表示，傳統 DRAM 價格必須在兩年內跌破基準情境超過 32% to 54%，記憶體買方才有真正理由違約長期供貨協議。這保護了美光科技 (MU:NASDAQ) 和 SK 海力士 (SKHY:NASDAQ) 創紀錄盈利背後的合約，而 HP (HPQ:NYSE) 等買方持續為記憶體支付更高價格。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron, SK hynix and Sandisk fell today after BNP Paribas downgraded Micron and Bank of America said semis estimate cuts have started. The cuts aim at 2028, and BNP’s calendar 2028 estimates for Micron sit 45% below consensus.
news.title: Warning for Micron Investors: Bank of America Says “Semis Cuts Have Started”
news.title_zh: 美光投資人警示：美銀表示「半導體估計下調已啟動」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：在 BNP Paribas 下調美光評級、美銀指出半導體估計下調已啟動後，美光、SK hynix 與 Sandisk 今日下跌。下調目標為 2028，BNP 對美光的曆年 2028 估計值較共識低 45%。

CrowdStrike’s record $419 million of net new ARR, up 58%, shows the attack surge turning into subscription revenue.

news.title_zh: 橋水基金認為發生破壞性網攻的機率為 1 分之 -3。CrowdStrike 工作量已經「上升 50%」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要橋水基金按一年內發生經濟破壞性網攻三分之一機率管理資金，事件響應公司據報已滿載。CrowdStrike 創紀錄的 $419 million 淨新增 ARR，上升 58%，顯示攻擊激增轉化為訂閱收入。

news.title_zh: Cloudflare 儘管「進入更高檔」，一個月內仍下跌 11%。是時候賣出，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Cloudflare 股價在過去一個月下跌 11%。一波同樣波及 Datadog 和 CrowdStrike 的 AI 和軟體拋售將其拖低，儘管 Cloudflare 剛公布近四年來最快的營收增長。

news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.
news.title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
news.title_zh: Palantir 飆升 10% 領漲軟體股。Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 也加入「Jensen Rally」
news.summary_zh: 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 在 24/7 華爾街表示，黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA 於週一帶動科技股上漲。納斯達克指數截至 1:30 下午 (東部時間) 上漲逾 7%，此前受週五拋售潮影響，盤前漲幅達 3%。晶片股群體上漲逾 13%。軟體股也上漲，但漲幅不均。微軟 (NASDAQ: MSFT) 和 Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) 各上漲約 3%，而 IGV 軟體 ETF 上漲 4%。最大贏家是受惠於主權 AI 和強大開放權重生態系的公司。Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) 領漲 10%，且 Palantir 一直是主權 AI 最響亮的支持者之一。Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) 上漲約 7%，ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) 上漲 5%，得益於其控制塔軟體引導客戶在模型和代理式工作負載之間切換。Anthropic 表現落後，因黃仁勳推動開放權重模型，對 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等領先實驗室構成壓力。Bleeker 的結論：若黃仁勳持續支持開放權重模型製造商，Palantir、Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 上漲 5% to 10%，應會持續優於軟體其餘部分 2% to 3% 的漲幅。

news.summary: CrowdStrike, Palantir and Cloudflare all posted record quarters, yet one of them does most of the heavy lifting in this basket. A five-year model tests whether a $7,500 stake can truly double, and which scenario it demands.

news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.
news.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
news.title_zh: Nebius 與 CoreWeave 上漲 21%，而 Oracle 在 Jensen 回歸後於週一錄得 12% 漲幅
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資官 Eric Bleeker 表示，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，新雲端股票週一反彈。美國東部時間 1:30 下午，Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) 和 CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) 各上漲 21%，IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) 上漲 25%，TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) 上漲 13%，Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) 上漲 12%。領先 ETF 顯示軟體上漲接近 4%，半導體上漲 13%。Bleeker 還指出了兩項公司特定事項。《紐約時報》報導，Anthropic 的需求龐大到 SpaceX 需要在十月前建立新數據中心以滿足訂單。週五，Oracle 表示已獲得其 OpenAI 合約所需的所有資金。Bleeker 指出 Nvidia 以資金、技術專長和晶片協助建立新雲端服務商。他稱這只是一日勝果。過去一個月 Nebius 下跌 38%，CoreWeave 12%，Oracle 10%。六個月來 Nebius 下跌超過 50%，Oracle 40%，CoreWeave 55%。Bleeker 指出拋售的三大驅動因素：利率上升和信用違約互換擴大、中期選舉後的政治擔憂，以及 Huang 的離職。只有最後一項已扭轉。展望未來，關注美聯儲利率路徑以及政治如何影響德州等項目地點。
